description: ROS 2 graph only; on a DDS-only setup use `list_endpoints`. Return info for a single ROS 2 topic. `topic` must be a fully qualified name, e.g. `/cmd_vel`. Returns a `TopicInfo` with `mode_effective` (`live` or `mock`) and, in live mode, `publisher_qos` and `subscription_qos` (`reliability` `reliable` / `best_effort` / `mixed`, `durability` `volatile` / `transient_local` / `mixed`, `endpoint_count`; `transient_local` marks a latched topic such as `/tf_static`; a side that is `null` says why in its `_note`) and `publisher_nodes` / `subscriber_nodes` (fully qualified node names). **Raises an MCP error** if the topic name is malformed, the topic is unknown to the active graph, or no `ros2` CLI is available. Read-only; no side effects.

topic.description: Fully qualified ROS2 topic name starting with `/`, e.g. `/cmd_vel` or `/camera/image_raw`. Each `/`-separated segment must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, and underscores; everything else (whitespace, quotes, shell metacharacters, `//`, trailing `/`) is rejected before reaching the `ros2` CLI.
topic.title: Topic

name: get_topic_info

SideQos.description: QoS of one side (publishers or subscriptions) of a ROS2 topic, as the `ros2` CLI reports it.

durability.description: Durability shared by the endpoints of this side, or `mixed` when they disagree. `transient_local` marks a latched topic such as `/tf_static`.
durability.title: Durability

endpoint_count.description: Endpoints of this side the values were read from.
endpoint_count.title: Endpoint Count

reliability.description: Reliability shared by the endpoints of this side, or `mixed` when they disagree.
reliability.title: Reliability

SideQos.title: SideQos

outputSchema.description: Detail of a single ROS2 topic: counts, QoS per side and the nodes on each side.

mode_effective.description: Runtime mode the adapter served this response in: `live` (real ROS2 introspection) or `mock` (deterministic fixtures). Lets a caller tell a real graph from a demo one without calling `health_check`.
mode_effective.title: Mode Effective

note.description: One sentence of context for the result. `None` means nothing to add.
note.title: Note

publisher_nodes.description: Fully qualified names of the nodes that publish the topic, from `ros2 topic info --verbose`. Empty when none is known.
publisher_nodes.title: Publisher Nodes

publisher_qos.description: QoS of the publishers. `None` when it was not read: see `publisher_qos_note`.

publisher_qos_note.description: Why `publisher_qos` is `None`. `None` when it is set.
publisher_qos_note.title: Publisher Qos Note

subscriber_nodes.description: Fully qualified names of the nodes that subscribe to the topic, same source. Empty when none is known.
subscriber_nodes.title: Subscriber Nodes

subscription_qos.description: QoS of the subscriptions. `None` when it was not read: see `subscription_qos_note`.

subscription_qos_note.description: Why `subscription_qos` is `None`. `None` when it is set.
subscription_qos_note.title: Subscription Qos Note
